units.source_text: 是晚源氏公子即赴左大臣邸宅招亲[\[34\]](#part1330.html#m34)。

en.t: That evening, Prince Genji immediately went to the Left Minister's residence to take his bride.

units.source_text: 结婚仪式之隆重，又是世间无比的。

en.t: The wedding ceremony was magnificently grand, unmatched anywhere in the world.

units.source_text: 左大臣看看这女婿，的确娇小玲珑，俊秀可爱。

en.t: When the Left Minister looked at this son-in-law, he found him truly delicate, graceful, handsome, and charming.

units.source_text: 葵姬比新郎年纪略长，似觉稍不相称，心中难以为情。

en.t: Lady Aoi was slightly older than the bridegroom and seemed to feel that they were not quite well matched, leaving her embarrassed at heart.
